desc: Ideation: confirmed answer = min over column masks c of Σ_rows min(dist(row,c), W-dist(row,c)), solvable by XOR convolution (freq ⊛ g) with FWHT in O(W·2^W).
Parse H, W and the H row strings into W-bit integer masks, building freq[mask] of size n=2^W.
Precompute ĝ[k]=G(popcount(k)) via closed form G(j)=Σ(-1)^a C(j,a)C(W-j,b)·g(a+b).
Implement Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (int64-safe), transform freq, multiply pointwise, inverse transform, divide by n.
Output the minimum value over all column masks c of the resulting convolution.
Verify correctness on samples 1-3 and edge cases (all zeros, all ones, W=1, H=1, duplicates).
Ensure performance for W=18 using numpy with pure-Python FWHT fallback.
